title: Developer-path dialog
purpose: Modal that lets a visitor choose how to start: heading-2 and 3 rows (heading-4, paragraph, secondary button). Opened by any action with opensDialog (hero buttons on /product/lattice, /product/governance, /security, /product/integrations); the dialog takes focus, Escape and overlay-click close, focus returns to the trigger.
retrievalIneligibleReason: Modal dialog opened by a hero button; it is a runtime overlay rendered into the document body, never page content, so it must not be retrieved as a section.

content.budgetRule: maxWords/maxChars = the maximum observed in the clone's own content for this field across every rendered instance (schema/examples/reference/*); list sizes = observed min/max. Never exceed; shorter is allowed.

assets.note: reference mode may use referenceRoles; generated mode must use generatedRoles (generation-safe only). See assets/asset-roles.json.

style.note: token props take token-catalog paths only (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json); allowed values = values observed in the clone (tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleProps).

responsive.behavior: rows are horizontal (text left, button right); panel padding 48

runtimeUi.behavior: fixed ink-900 80% + 4px blur overlay (no transition), panel max 1050 wide / 90vh fading and scaling over 200ms on open and close, <html> scroll locked while open
